headline: 131 all out: Bangladesh collapse against Australia in series opener
summary: A strong start in the powerplay turned into a batting disaster as the Tigers lost 8 wickets before reaching 100 runs.
details: Bangladesh were bowled out for 131 runs in the first T20 of the series against Australia on Wednesday. Despite a promising start, a severe middle-order collapse saw the team all out with one over remaining.

The Tigers looked strong during the powerplay, but wickets began to tumble rapidly once that phase ended. Controlled bowling from the Australian side left Bangladesh struggling, with the top eight batsmen returning to the pavilion before the score reached 100.
A significant blow came when Rishad Hossain was caught near the boundary line while attempting to hit a six off Xavier Bartlett.
The innings saw a late fightback from Mehedi and Rishad. Mehedi remained unbeaten on 29 runs off 22 balls, helping the team reach a more respectable total.
The final wicket fell when Mustafizur Rahman was given out LBW following a successful review by Australia, ending the Bangladeshi innings.
caption:
From a flying start to a total collapse. 🇧🇩

Bangladesh bowled out for 131 against Australia.

Bangladesh were bowled out for 131 runs in the first T20 of the series against Australia on Wednesday. Despite a promising start, a severe middle-order collapse saw the team all out with one over remaining.

The Tigers looked strong during the powerplay, but wickets began to tumble rapidly once that phase ended. Controlled bowling from the Australian side left Bangladesh struggling, with the top eight batsmen returning to the pavilion before the score reached 100.

A significant blow came when Rishad Hossain was caught near the boundary line while attempting to hit a six off Xavier Bartlett.

The innings saw a late fightback from Mehedi and Rishad. Mehedi remained unbeaten on 29 runs off 22 balls, helping the team reach a more respectable total.

The final wicket fell when Mustafizur Rahman was given out LBW following a successful review by Australia, ending the Bangladeshi innings.

headline: 661 children dead as measles outbreak death toll reaches 661
summary: Four children died within a single 24-hour window as the outbreak continues to claim lives.
details: A measles outbreak has resulted in the death of 661 children, according to recent reports.
The situation has escalated rapidly, with four children dying within the last 24 hours alone.
The outbreak continues to put pressure on healthcare facilities as the death toll rises.
Health authorities are monitoring the situation to prevent further fatalities among children.
